job.name: hist_host_b
job.meaning: женщина ~30, русые волосы в небрежном пучке, бордовая водолазка, фон — зал музея с витринами старинных предметов
job.prompt: Photorealistic photo of a Russian woman about 30, light-brown hair in a loose low bun, small simple earrings, a burgundy turtleneck. Background: a quiet museum hall with glass display cases of old artefacts and a dark wooden wall, softly out of focus, warm gallery light. FRAMING: vertical 9:16, waist-up, both shoulders fully inside the frame, centred, top of head about 14% below the upper edge, face large and sharp, looking straight into the lens. Expression: calm, intrigued storyteller about to share a secret, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, NO broad smile. Look: a real frame shot on a modern camera, true-to-life colours, natural unretouched skin with pores, NOT a studio glamour portrait, NOT CGI. No text, no logos, no watermark.
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary person (not a celebrity, not a model), looks genuinely real.
